from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Case(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document relevant to matching with results."""
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Full name of the court that issued the judgment")
    court_region: str | None = Field(description="Region or province of the court")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case (Criminal, Civil, Private Prosecution, etc.)")
    defendants: list[str] = Field(description="Names of defendants or accused parties")
    appellants: list[str] = Field(description="Names of appellants or petitioners")
    charges_or_claims: list[str] = Field(description="Specific charges or civil claims involved")
    outcome_summary: str | None = Field(description="General outcome (e.g. 'Appeal dismissed', 'Guilty', 'Retrial denied')")
    sentence_or_penalty_details: list[str] = Field(description="Specific sentencing details, dates, or amounts")
    fee_info: str | None = Field(description="Court fee amount and payer if mentioned")
    legal_basis_citations: list[str] = Field(description="Specific laws or articles cited (e.g. Criminal Procedure Law Art 253)")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of legal document (Judgment, Ruling, etc.)")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt supporting the extraction")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[Case]
